name: 光流异常检测
description: 使用光流分析检测视频中的不自然运动模式以识别AI生成内容。
useCase: 通过运动场分析检测深度伪造和AI生成视频
mechanism: Computes dense 光流 between consecutive video frames and analyzes the resulting motion field for anomalies. AI生成的 videos often produce unnatural flow patterns, such as 不一致的 motion directions, unrealistic acceleration, or flow discontinuities at manipulation boundaries.
source: Amerini et al. (2019) - Deepfake Video Detection through Optical Flow Based CNN, ICCVW
algorithm: 密集光流(Farneback) + 流场统计分析
parameters: 光流方法: Farneback, 金字塔缩放: 0.5, 层数: 3, 窗口: 15, 迭代: 3
strengths:
• 捕获时间篡改伪影
• 适用于面部和全场景深度伪造
• 对空间后处理具有鲁棒性
• 能定位视频中的篡改区域
limitations:
• 需要视频中有足够的运动
• 静态场景产生弱信号
• 每帧对的计算成本高
• 相机抖动可能引入噪声

references.title: Amerini, I. et al. (2019). Deepfake Video Detection through Optical Flow Based CNN. ICCVW.
Li, Y. & Lyu, S. (2019). Exposing DeepFake Videos By Detecting Face Warping Artifacts. CVPR Workshop.
Caldelli, R. et al. (2021). Optical Flow Based CNN for Detection of Unlearnt Deepfake Manipulations. Pattern Recognition Letters.
